name: Reading Highlight
description: A paragraph sits dim, then lights up word by word as a reading head passes, with a soft two-word leading edge; key phrases light in the accent.
move: A paragraph sits dim, then lights up word by word as a reading head passes, with a soft two-word leading edge; key phrases light in the accent.
how: Deterministic draw(t). Each word carries a --lit custom property (0–1) that drives color-mix from dim ink to ink, or to the accent for <b> key words. A reading head moves through the words on Flow ease (0.42,0,0.58,1); each word lights over a 2.2-word soft edge. Opacity enters and exits on smoothsteps.
adapt: Edit the paragraph; wrap key phrases in <b>. SOFT sets the width of the lit edge. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the "Scroll-read highlight" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
